messages:
Sasha: Quick pass on this week's GPU forecast — please scan and flag blockers. TL;DR: baseline +6% WoW due to scheduled retrains and a customer onboarding. Need to lock reserve by EOD Wed. Draft by region below.

capacity-bot: Automated snapshot generated: see CSV. Heatmap -> https://dash.redwood/forecast/1813456 :bar_chart:
```
region,cluster,avail_gpus,proj_gpu_hours,expected_burn_pct,notes
NA-east,prod-a,240,32000,78,enterprise onboarding +5%
NA-east,burst-pool,64,4800,12, standby for spikes
EU-west,prod-b,200,26000,70, retrains Wed night
AP-south,prod-c,48,5200,60, low baseline, planned maintenance Thu
Global,preemptible,128,7600,18, opportunistic workloads
```

Raj: Heads-up — Enterprise customer "Atlas" moved ramp to Tue. Expect ~+12% in NA-east peak windows (13:00-17:00 UTC). Can we convert some burst -> reserved for Weds? @Sasha

Tyler: I can temp-pin 32 GPUs from burst-pool to na-east-reserve. Suggest using preemptible fallback for non-SLA retrains to avoid commit. Cost delta calc: ~$1.8k/day if we reserve 32 on-demand.

Marta: Re net: eu-west inter-rack egress jitter last night impacted cross-region pulls. Not comfortable shifting EU capacity to NA until we confirm egress is stable. I have a ticket with logs -> https://incidents.redwood/4521

Janelle: Cost note — if we flip burst->reserve we'll hit committed spend thresholds and bump forecasted monthly Opex by ~7%. We should prune models with <5% utilization (we have 9 candidates).

Sasha: Agreed on pruning list + preemptible fallbacks. Action items: 1) Tyler to allocate 32 GPUs to NA-east reserve (temp) 2) Marta to validate eu-west egress by Tue 09:00 UTC 3) Janelle to send prune candidate list by EOD. I'll lock reserve if no objections.

Tyler: Taking action. Running reserve command now:
```bash
redwood reserve set --pool na-east-reserve --gpus 32 --until 2026-03-20 --reason "Atlas onboarding temp"
```

capacity-bot: Reserve request queued: ticket #CI-7842. Projected impact updated in dashboard.

Marta: I'll validate egress and post results in this thread by 08:45 UTC Tue.

Janelle: Sending prune candidates in 30m.

Raj: Thanks — I'll coordinate with Atlas to shift a small part of the ramp to Thu if we hit contention.

Tyler: Closing loop: reserve request submitted, will monitor burn and rollback if preemptible fallback underperforms. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Perfect. If anyone sees >90% burn in NA-east before Tue AM, ping @oncall and escalate.
